description: SEQ ordinals with \s chapter restarts, formats and separators
loLimitations: LibreOffice ignores \s chapter restarts and the chapter prefix (renders continuous ordinals: Figure 1, Figure 2, Figure III) and drops the \s switch from the instruction on resave. Word's own update writes the chapter as a separate STYLEREF field; docen caches the prefix inside the SEQ result (documented Word interop deviation).
